params.name: Region
params.description: Filters articles published in {region}. The region should be passed in English, using the reference data linked below.

params.name: Category
params.description: Filters articles by {category}. Note: the category (topic) should be passed in English, using the reference data linked below.

params.name: Time_Period
params.description: Filters articles published within the last {time_period} hours. Valid time_periods range from 1 up to 168 hours

params.name: size
params.description: The number of results you wish to have returned in the request. The default is 150 if this is omitted. The maximum you can specify is 500.
